items.question: How long before I see results?
items.answer: Our formulas are designed for a 3-month protocol: a full maturation cycle for eggs or sperm takes about 90 days. It's rare to see results before the end of the first 3-month cycle — consistency matters more than speed.

items.question: Are your products safe and certified?
items.answer: Yes. All our supplements are 100% natural, manufactured in GMP-certified facilities, with no artificial additives.

items.question: Can my partner and I take BellaFert and FertiMen together?
items.answer: Absolutely — that's exactly the point of the Couple Pack, which combines BellaFert and FertiMen to support both partners at the same time.

items.question: Should I see a doctor before starting?
items.answer: We recommend asking your doctor for advice if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or undergoing treatment. Each product page details the specific precautions.

items.question: What are the delivery times?
items.answer: We deliver anywhere in Morocco within 24 to 48 business hours.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: You can pay cash on delivery or by card, whichever you prefer.

items.question: Do you ship outside Morocco?
items.answer: For now, our deliveries are limited to Moroccan territory. Contact us if you have a specific request.

items.question: What if I'm not satisfied?
items.answer: All our products are covered by our money-back guarantee. Contact us and we'll find a solution quickly.

items.question: How can I track my order?
items.answer: A tracking link is sent to you as soon as your order ships. For any question, our team is reachable at hello@biofertmaroc.com.

items.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
items.answer: Contact us as soon as possible after your purchase — as long as the order hasn't shipped, we can usually change or cancel it.
